principles: No backward-compat: delete the legacy-koala symbols, do not stub or deprecate them.
Keep the residue gate green throughout; defer flipping/renaming it to story 4.
Preserve all non-koala behavior; the only intended behavioral change is dropping legacy-koala migration support.
Update every removed symbol's call sites and tests in the same change so the build and suite stay green.
drivers: Shared main branch: a broken build or red test would also block the concurrent agent working in this repo.
assertNoLegacyKoalaWritePath is called from core config loading; its removal must not break loadConfig.
The koala-residue gate must keep passing this story (story 4 flips it to zero-tolerance).

options.name: surgical-in-place-deletion
pros: No dead koala symbols left behind
Lets story 4 flip the gate to zero-tolerance cleanly
cons: Touches ~15 core files + their tests at once
Requires careful call-site adjustment in config/dev-memory/activity-log

options.name: noop-stub-and-deprecate
cons: Leaves dead code the residue gate would still have to exempt
User explicitly rejected keeping any compat

rationale: The user directive is total removal with no compatibility shims; surgical deletion leaves zero legacy-koala symbols so story 4 can flip the gate to zero-tolerance, whereas stubbing would retain koala identifiers and contradict the directive.

preMortem.trigger: config.loadConfig or handlers/dev-memory relied on the guard's throw for control flow
preMortem.consequence: The CLI fails to load config; every command breaks, also blocking the concurrent agent on shared main
preMortem.mitigation: Inspect every caller before removal; the guard only throws for legacy koala paths that no longer exist, so remove the call and the function together; run the full packages/main test suite plus a live lattice session_brief smoke before dev_finish

preMortem.scenario: Removing the legacy activity-log archive reader breaks stale-detection or the activity tail
preMortem.trigger: stale-detector or readActivityLogTail merges activity.legacy-koala.jsonl and assumes the source exists
preMortem.consequence: Stale-detection or telemetry throws or returns wrong data
preMortem.mitigation: Remove the legacy source from the merge cleanly so only the primary activity.jsonl remains; update stale-detector references; rely on the activity-log and stale-detector tests to confirm

preMortem.scenario: Tests asserting legacy-koala compat reference removed symbols and fail to compile
preMortem.trigger: storydir-inside-gitroot-suite or managed-assets tests assert assertNoLegacyKoalaWritePath / koala-*.md behavior
preMortem.consequence: tsc or the test suite goes red and the gate blocks advancement
preMortem.mitigation: Delete or retarget those specific compat assertions in the same change; tsc and the test suite must be green before dev_finish

preMortem.scenario: The residue gate flips to FAIL after removing the dual-accept regex
preMortem.trigger: Removing (?:koala|lattice) leaves a bare koala token that classify()'s exemptions no longer strip
preMortem.consequence: verify-koala-residue.mjs fails, blocking REVIEW to TEST
preMortem.mitigation: Run node scripts/verify-koala-residue.mjs after each edit and ensure removed-compat lines leave no leftover koala token in product code
